context: Daichi and Mei plan an early-morning departure.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (先ほど/時刻/とおり/午前/前回) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 明日は、午前に出発しよか。
lines.en: Let's leave in the morning tomorrow.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 時刻は、何時くらいがいいですか?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 前回どおり、八時でええかな。
lines.en: Like last time, eight should be fine.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 先ほど、天気を調べたんです。
lines.en: I checked the weather just now.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おお、で、予報のとおり晴れる?
lines.en: Oh, and per the forecast, will it be sunny?
lines.style: curious Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ええ、午前は晴れるそうです。
lines.en: Yes, it'll be sunny in the morning.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほな、前回より早う着けるな。
lines.en: Then we'll arrive earlier than last time.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 時刻どおりに、出ましょうね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
